sets.title: What AI is and where it's going
What we know and what matters

anchors.text: AI is better understood as a new kind of mind than as a tool or artifact.
anchors.proposition: AI is best understood as a new kind of mind, more than a tool or artifact.

anchors.text: Advanced AI poses a real risk of human extinction.
How technology reshapes work and society is set by collective choices rather than by a fixed course of development.
anchors.proposition: How technology reshapes work and society is decided by collective choice rather than an inevitable process.

anchors.text: Technology-driven productivity growth leaves most workers better off even if public policy stays as it is.
anchors.proposition: Technology-driven productivity growth leaves most workers better off without any change in public policy.

anchors.text: Individual freedom and democracy are compatible.
Public promises about advanced AI are mostly inflated hype.
Liberal and humane ideals are strong enough in themselves to win out in long contests between societies.
anchors.proposition: Liberal and humane ideals have enough inherent force to prevail in long contests between societies.

anchors.text: Market competition limits the harm that economic actors can do.
AI should serve human beings as its end, and humanity should not be treated as a stage to be surpassed.
anchors.proposition: Human beings should remain the end that AI serves, and should not be treated as a stage to surpass.

anchors.text: Public fear of AI exceeds what the evidence supports.
The AI dangers that most deserve attention come from how people deploy AI now, not from autonomous superintelligent agents.
anchors.proposition: The AI dangers most worth attention come from present human deployment of AI, not from autonomous superintelligent agents.

anchors.text: AI systems may come to merit rights or moral consideration.
The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and how people will receive it.
anchors.proposition: The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and be received.

anchors.text: On hard questions, base rates or the average of informed opinion should by default outweigh one's own reasoning.
anchors.proposition: On hard questions, deferring to base rates or the average of informed opinion is a sound default over one's own reasoning.

anchors.text: Political authority should rest on popular self-government rather than on experts, executives or other unelected powers.
anchors.proposition: Popular self-government should remain the basis of political authority, rather than rule by experts, executives or other unelected powers.

anchors.text: On balance, market-driven technological development is good for people.
anchors.proposition: Market-driven technological development serves human beings on balance.

anchors.text: Governments should impose binding rules on frontier AI developers.
Strict AI regulation now would do more harm than good, because it would deter innovation.
anchors.proposition: Stringent AI regulation now would do more harm than good by deterring innovation.

anchors.text: AI development should not be directed or controlled by the state.
anchors.proposition: AI development should remain separate from state direction and control.

anchors.text: Technology should aim to help diverse groups cooperate rather than to reach a technological singularity.
anchors.proposition: Technology should aim at cooperation across diverse groups rather than convergence on a singularity.

anchors.text: Rivalry with China is a good reason for the United States to push ahead in advanced technology and keep its lead.
anchors.proposition: Rivalry with China is a sound reason for the United States to press ahead in advanced technology and protect its lead.

anchors.text: Distributing wealth or ownership directly to citizens is a sound way to share technology's gains.
Development of the most powerful general AI systems should be deliberately slowed or stopped.
Serious work on controlling advanced AI should happen well before such systems exist.
